messages:
marie (PM): quick sync — we need a clear rule for prioritization frameworks + A/B/canary sequencing for Q2 initiatives. do we standardize on RICE or mix with impact/effort for fast wins? @alex @jia
alex (eng): leaning hybrid. RICE for multi-quarter infra or dedicated offers (lets quantify reach + cost). impact/effort for feature toggles and small UX items.
marie (PM): agreed. want to capture that in the playbook so PMs pick the right rubric without ad-hoc debates. also need a canonical canary plan for experiments that touch runtime (models, routing, batching).
jia (Data): +1 hybrid. remind folks that "reach" needs a concrete metric (monthly active callers, requests/day) not vague product talk. for model changes we should add "quality risk" as a multiplier in RICE.
tanvi (PMM): from go-to-market side, we need a slow rollout for partner-facing features. canary windows should be coordinated with comms.
sam (SRE): for anything touching serving/runtime we require: 1) smoke canary, 2) automated rollback hooks in the deploy pipeline, 3) clear SLO thresholds.
marie (PM): draft proposal: use RICE for large initiatives, impact/effort for <2 sprint tasks. for canaries: a default ramp + rollback thresholds we can reuse. sharing draft below. feedback welcome.
marie (PM): ```
canary_plan:
  stages:
    - pct: 1
      duration: 2h
    - pct: 5
      duration: 4h
    - pct: 25
      duration: 24h
    - pct: 100
      duration: 48h
rollback_conditions:
  - error_rate > baseline * 1.5
  - p95_latency > baseline + 50%
  - user_quality_regression > 1%
alerting: on any rollback condition -> paging (oncall) + auto-toggle-to-fallback
```
alex (eng): looks reasonable. small ask: add a short-circuit stage for critical infra (start at 5% immediately) and a throttled ramp when backend caches are cold.
sam (SRE): add a health-check gating rule: if any infra metric (GPU OOM, queue length) spikes by 2x, abort. also keep a manual hold point between 25% and 100% for cross-org signoff.
jia (Data): for "user_quality_regression" define measurement: run held-out eval suite + live prompt set, threshold is a >1% drop in composite score or >2% rise in hallucination rate. capture sample size for statistical power.
tanvi (PMM): can we include a canary cohort tag so we can exclude partner accounts from early ramps? want to avoid partners seeing half-baked responses.
marie (PM): good call — add exclusion list and tenant tags. also propose default traffic allocation logic: weighted by region then by customer tier; canaries should be region-local where feasible.
alex (eng): implementation note: router supports percent-based releases + per-tenant allowlist. I'll add an API to the rollout controller: `rollout.set(percent, filters)` and a dry-run flag.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout-controller/feature/llm-routing v2 -> prod (initiated by @alex)
marie (PM): for prioritization decisions, let's codify the tie-breaker: when RICE scores are within 10%, prefer lower implementation risk; if still tied, prefer customer-impact signals (NPS mentions, revenue-opportunity).
jia (Data): can we attach an automated RICE template that pulls reach from usage telemetry and effort from engineering estimates? reduces guesswork.
alex (eng): yes — we can add a lightweight script to populate reach/effort from dashboards and a checkbox for "quality risk".
sam (SRE): operational checklist for any rollout touching inference:
- run chaos job in staging for 24h
- validate autoscaler SLOs under canary load
- ensure KV cache warmup plan exists
- add rollback toggle in console
marie (PM): decision for this thread: adopt hybrid prioritization (RICE for big bets, impact/effort for quick wins). formalize RICE template with a quality-risk factor. adopt default canary_plan above, with exceptions for critical infra noted by alex + sam.
tanvi (PMM): noted — I'll draft the comms cadence for canary windows (pre-announce to partners + post-mortem template).
alex (eng): I'll PR rollout-controller changes and add the auto-rollback hooks. target: merge + staging smoke by EOD Friday.
jia (Data): I'll write the eval harness for live prompt set and attach to the CI gate.
sam (SRE): I'll add the SLO checks to the deploy pipeline and create the PagerDuty runbook.
marie (PM): great — thanks everyone. I'll update the playbook doc and tag leads for each step. if anyone has objections to the plan, flag here before EOD. :thumbsup:
